name: rm-mcp
description: Find, read, view and transcribe your reMarkable notes, and send documents to the tablet.
long_description: Connects Claude to your reMarkable library through the reMarkable Cloud (needs a reMarkable account with cloud sync). Read tools find, list, read and view documents, notebooks, PDFs and EPUBs, including highlights; Claude transcribes handwriting by looking at pages and saves the text so it becomes searchable. Write tools send PDFs, EPUBs and Markdown to the tablet and rename, move and create folders in dry-run-first batches with undo. Nothing is ever deleted.

tools.name: remarkable_find
tools.description: Search names, text, highlights and transcripts; filter by folder, type and date.

tools.name: remarkable_list
tools.description: List a folder's documents and subfolders.

tools.name: remarkable_read
tools.description: Read a document's text per page.

tools.name: remarkable_view
tools.description: See pages as images, handwriting included.

tools.name: remarkable_annotations
tools.description: Highlights and handwritten marks on PDFs and books.

tools.name: remarkable_save_transcript
tools.description: Save the text of a handwritten page so it is searchable.

tools.name: remarkable_status
tools.description: Connection, library size, index and settings.

tools.name: remarkable_send
tools.description: Put a PDF, EPUB, URL or Markdown on the tablet.

tools.name: remarkable_organize
tools.description: Rename, move and create folders as one batch; dry run by default.

one_time_code.title: One-time code
one_time_code.description: First use only: get a code at https://my.remarkable.com/device/apps/connect and paste it here. rm-mcp exchanges it for a token it keeps in its own file. Leave empty if you already ran `uvx rm-mcp@latest setup`.

root_path.title: Only this folder
root_path.description: Optional. Show Claude only this folder of your library, such as /Work.
